'''Noah Franke''' is a Star Wars CCG player. He was runner-up at the 2004 Oregon State Championship in Beaverton on 19 June 2004, losing both games of the Final Confrontation to Edward Fones.<ref name="pcf-3383-46989">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=46989#46989 2004 Oregon State SWCCG Championship Event], Glenn Hall, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (31 May 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040625210617/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=47102%26amp Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="pcf-3383-47778">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=47778#47778 2004 Oregon State SWCCG Championship Event], David Kangas, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (20 June 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040716072317/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=47947%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> On 30 July 2004 he ran a tournament in Salem, Oregon.<ref name="pcf-3781-51682">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=51682#51682 Anyone know about a tourney on the 31st in Oregon? ECF????], David Kangas, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (31 July 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040908230957/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?t=3781%26amp Internet Archive]</ref>

== Card credits ==
The printed credit lines of 1 [[Players Committee]] [[Virtual cards|Virtual card]] name Noah Franke (1 original concept credit).<ref name="labels">[https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/resources/card_labels.json card_labels.json] in billbisco/swccg-gemp (commit 0bc4377d9): the printed labels of every Players Committee Virtual card, transcribed from the PC's card images. Field definitions: [https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/docs/card_labels.md docs/card_labels.md].</ref> The credited card is in [[Virtual Block 6]], dated 2009 on this wiki. The concept credit also names the event or award the concept came from: Washington States 2006 (1 card). The full list of everyone credited is at [[Card Credits#Noah Franke|Card Credits]].
